name: zrndr_span_occlusion_build_span_list_fast
description: zRndr_SpanOcclusion::BuildSpanListFast emits the pending span as the only visible span and advances the span-node allocation cursor.
known_limits: VC5SP3 compile-only verification is recorded for the production source body; tier S byte comparison is deferred to a coherent zRndr span-occlusion pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x491da0 validates clearing g_spanAllocCursor->next, storing the pending span in spanList[0], writing spanCount to one, and advancing g_spanAllocCursor by one zRndr::SpanNodePartial.
The native fast span-list smoke verifies next-link clearing, visible span pointer output, spanCount write, and pool cursor advancement while ignoring the column argument.
